explicitSupersession.qualification: Only this incident-authorized replacement joins the failed original cell to a later pass. Original rows and effective flags remain unchanged; no blanket latest-wins masking.

weighted300.qualification: Same 20 real card weights with normal random modifiers/forms. The filed Exploration effect is outside the fuzz target domain. This is not 300 forced type changes or 803 selected games; no unreported modifier counts or branch values are inferred.

effectLimits: Node first-legal X=0 rows show no positive Burst gain/score claim. Canonical enemy Burst base emits pointsScored; its amount and X are not emitted by the standard report.
